# umbrage

> Offense or annoyance (usually as take umbrage, meaning become offended or annoyed)

> a feeling of anger or annoyance caused by something offensive


## Example

- *Since he was so in love with her, he took umbrage at her comments, even though she had only meant to gently tease him.*
